        <payload><?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item display_value="Commvault - Access">3a17fea74722ee1097744049116d433e</cat_item><cat_variable/><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>Initialize form</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onLoad() {
	
	// Set business service to the cat item's CI
	var catItemId = g_form.getUniqueValue(); //Cat item sys_id
	var ajax = new GlideAjax( 'ajaxAccessCatalogRequestHelper' );
	ajax.addParam( 'sysparm_name', 'getCatalogItemCI' );
	ajax.addParam( 'sysparm_catalog_item_id', catItemId );
	ajax.getXML( getCatalogItemCICallBack );

	function getCatalogItemCICallBack (response) {
		var answer = response.responseXML.documentElement.getAttribute( "answer" );
		var result = JSON.parse( answer );
		if (result) {
			g_form.setValue( "business_service", result );
		}
	}	
	
	// This static list of service offering groups allows the catalog form to display only the offerings from the user-selected group, there could be a better way of doing this by setting some properties in the service offerings themselves
	var serviceOfferingGroups = [
		'4ba9a2a747aeae1097744049116d4321,3b2a66e747aeae1097744049116d4321,6b3aaee747aeae1097744049116d438e,441a66e747aeae1097744049116d43fe,f71a6ae747aeae1097744049116d432b',
		'a86aaee747aeae1097744049116d43be,bc8a6a2b47aeae1097744049116d4305,c67aa22b47aeae1097744049116d4317,ce5aa22b47aeae1097744049116d4355,124aaee747aeae1097744049116d4396,c76aaee747aeae1097744049116d436b'
	];
	g_form.setValue("so_groups", JSON.stringify(serviceOfferingGroups));
	g_form.addOption("so_selected_group", '0', 'Commvault');
	g_form.addOption("so_selected_group", '1', 'Metallic / Commvault Cloud');
	g_form.setValue('so_selected_group', '0');
	
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>bcrepeault_admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-07-11 13:45:42</sys_created_on><sys_customer_update>false</sys_customer_update><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>8317fea74722ee1097744049116d4363</sys_id><sys_mod_count>29</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Initialize form</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_replace_on_upgrade>false</sys_replace_on_upgrade><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_8317fea74722ee1097744049116d4363</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>bcrepeault_admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-07-25 12:06:30</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onLoad</type><u_fx_inactive>false</u_fx_inactive><u_source/><u_target/><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client><sys_es_latest_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><id>8317fea74722ee1097744049116d4363</id><sys_created_by>bcrepeault_admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-07-11 14:06:29</sys_created_on><sys_id>d3db76674762ee1097744049116d43e0</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>bcrepeault_admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-07-11 14:06:29</sys_updated_on><table>catalog_script_client</table><use_es_latest>false</use_es_latest></sys_es_latest_script></record_update></payload>
